sloka: तेन सिंहप्रणादेन नामविश्रावणेन च।ज्याशब्देन च भीमेन त्रासयामास वानरान् ।। ६.७१.६ ।।
transliteration: tena siṁhapraṇādena nāmaviśrāvaṇena ca।jyāśabdena ca bhīmena trāsayāmāsa vānarān ।। 6.71.6 ।।

translations.english: By that lionroar, and proclamation of his name (by the sound of the twang) frightening the Vanaras he struck terror.
